title: Budget Plan Year-End Accounting Basis for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
A budget plan on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is trued up by setting the cost the member ran up over the plan year against the collection the plan took over that year. The plan year is counted over the 12 months ending on the handling date.

## The quantities

**The year's cost** is the fuel billed on the account over the plan year, plus the recognised share of the money applied against pre-buy bookings over that year, plus the recognised share of the fees billed over that year, rounded to two decimal places. None of the money applied against pre-buy bookings is recognised. The whole of the fees billed is recognised.

**The plan's collection** is the instalments billed over the plan year.

**The allowance set against the difference** is nothing.

**The difference** is the year's cost less the plan's collection less the allowance, rounded to two decimal places, and is billed to the member where it stands above nothing and credited to the account where it stands below nothing.

**The rate the difference bears** is nothing.

**The service charge borne on the difference** is the difference, where it stands above nothing, at the rate the difference bears for each whole month since an instalment was last billed on the account, rounded to two decimal places.

**The true-up** is the difference plus the service charge borne on it, rounded to two decimal places.

The rounding falls at three points and no others: on the year's cost once it is assembled, on the difference once the collection and the allowance have come off it, and on the true-up once the service charge has gone onto it.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

Suppose that over the plan year an account carries 4200.00 USD of fuel billed, 900.00 USD applied against pre-buy bookings, 260.00 USD of fees billed, and 4000.00 USD of instalments billed.

- The year's cost: 4200.00 USD of fuel, nothing of the 900.00 USD applied against bookings, and the whole 260.00 USD of fees, coming to 4460.00 USD.
- The plan's collection: 4000.00 USD.
- The difference: 4460.00 less 4000.00 less nothing, coming to 460.00 USD. It stands above nothing, so it is billed to the member.
- The service charge borne on it: the difference at a rate of nothing, coming to 0.00 USD, whatever the months since an instalment was last billed.
- The true-up: 460.00 plus 0.00, coming to 460.00 USD.

Had the instalments billed come to 4700.00 USD instead, the difference would be 240.00 USD below nothing, and the true-up would be credited to the account rather than billed to the member.
